verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal's API explicitly supports creating locations/zones and registering readers (via serial number, registration code, or order number) programmatically, and the full API-based integration path plus OpenAPI spec and general Stripe agent/MCP tooling make agent-driven end-to-end provisioning plausible and well-documented. missing for 10: no explicit example showing an AI agent performing the full create-location-then-register-reader flow via API, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent-orchestrated provisioning workflow.
